title: iOS 1.16 — Flight strip, Start re-times your flight, one icing card
body:
- Flight strip on the Observed tab: see where you are along your route at a glance, with your destination's weather at your expected arrival time.
- Start re-times your flight: pressing Start takes your real take-off as the departure time, updates the observations straight away, then every five minutes.
- One icing card, graded for the aircraft you fly: FIKI and non-FIKI aircraft get their own assessment, and you're told if your aircraft profile isn't marked FIKI.
- A new advisory flags IFR departures from airfields with no instrument procedures.
- The cross-section opens with the same layers and look as the website.
- Forecast map links open on the right day and time.
- Fixes: runway ends, storms that have already passed, TAF period reading, and more reliable briefings when a weather model is slow to respond.
